red_expected: Business closure evaluation program fields do not match the closed contract
green_rule: Freeze the exact input, test, contract, protocol and tools before the red entry; then change only private business-version routing and nullable unmodeled reference validation/result version. No public selector, physics, resource, threshold or original v1 behavior changes.
input_rule: Persist the entire actual new v2 call before its entry. Same inherited model/resource declarations do not make this a rerun of an old v1 original; private reference contract is the new behavior under test.
failure_rule: Unique red/green directories, attempt before call and terminal after all exits. Retain failures and partial outputs, no automatic retry or overwrite; changes need a new frozen correction.
durable_set: Pinned Git source, public fixture/descriptor, private v2 materializer, test/contract/protocol/runner/stager; manifest/job/attempt/terminal/logs, pre-call input and complete native outputs. Caches excluded; detailed input/native remain private server, necessary summaries and hashes returned.
